title: 이레즈미 풀 솔로 #055 · hourglass bombshell · Madhubani peacock · 뒷모습 · 검정 배경 · 아게하

Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a deep blue-black complexion, late 20s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, thick twist-out curls in chestnut brown — full body Madhubani peacock irezumi covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE. Bold black ink outlines — BLAZING DEEP BLUE Madhubani peacock formations with fanned tail feathers filled with fine line patterns across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID ORANGE and PINK flower-and-dot detail filling every gap, NO airbrush NO gradient wash. Pose: back fully to camera — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, ankle-strap stilettos entirely in the exact same colours as her own body art — blazing deep blue, vivid orange and pink — NOT black, NOT dark, NOT plain — the footwear must be a bright, saturated, glossy colour taken straight from her own body art, each with a very tall razor-thin tapered heel and a hidden front platform, a natural relaxed stance with her weight settled on her feet.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, round nails each as long as her forearm is wide, painted in the same colours as her body art.
Jewelry: a gold belly chain with a small pendant at her navel, a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, and heavy gold rings on every finger. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT painted — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Senegalese woman (Black African features: a heart-shaped face with wide high cheekbones tapering to a small pointed chin, large almond eyes with long natural lashes, a slim nose with a delicate tip, full lips with a defined cupid's bow, high arched eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: thick black eyeliner, extremely long dramatic false lashes top and bottom, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy peach-pink lips.

Background: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so her extreme height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
